rules.description: Universal Keyboard Config: Fn/Emoji, Brightness, Volume, and Music Control

manipulators.description: Fn for Emoji/Native Fn passthrough (Internal)
Fn for Emoji/Native Fn passthrough (Logitech)
Fn+F8 or Cmd+F8 -> Apple Music.app Script

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'if application \"Music\" is running then' -e 'tell application \"System Events\"' -e 'if exists (window 1 of process \"Music\") then' -e 'tell application \"Music\" to playpause' -e 'else' -e 'tell process \"Music\" to activate' -e 'tell application \"Music\" to playpause' -e 'end if' -e 'end tell' -e 'else' -e 'do shell script \"open /System/Applications/Music.app\"' -e 'delay 0.5' -e 'repeat with i from 1 to 100' -e 'if application \"Music\" is running then' -e 'delay 0.3' -e 'repeat with j from 1 to 10' -e 'tell application \"Music\" to play' -e 'delay 0.1' -e 'end repeat' -e 'exit repeat' -e 'else' -e 'delay 0.3' -e 'end if' -e 'end repeat' -e 'end if'
